notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content: [p]Hello, Hi. Hey. Bonjour! Guten Tag![/p][p]Update with some things up now.[/p][h3]⁉️ New Area[/h3][p]A mysterious building has appeared for a possible future mystery. Try and find it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/b7d6ed4775b59799b6855f8e218a551927631add.png"][/img][/p][h3]💧 New Water[/h3][p]Updated the water shader, used screen position to make it less transparent from where you are looking.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/4c64b76645a32bff8329851afa5198d4eb88f81d.png"][/img][/p][h3]🔧 Fixes and Adjustments and Additions[/h3][list][*][p]Added a sound effect for the sliding automatic door.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stick markers on the mini-map going under some trees.[/p][/*][*][p]Mini-map now shows slightly more distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Start menu background graphics some.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some jagged parts on the ground.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🦆 Duck[/h3][p]Fixed [i]that[/i] duck walking under the terrain AND added a worn path under to show it's walked that loop non-stop for many years.  🦆 👻?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/38bf8507ff45fdde57611a88d79a1721549b8e01.png"][/img][/p][p]Ok that's it for this update.[/p]
